scope: exploratory label-set coverage and indicator agreement; no independent benchmark

independent_benchmark.reason: No independent physical state reference with evaluable coverage; the divertor Thomson check is in docs/labeler/results/detachment_te_check.json.

label_set: geometry-gated TangTV state, checked against divertor Thomson Te
interpretation: TangTV + Afrac agreement (tier certain; agreement of two indicators, not a confidence level) is the TangTV vote with an agreeing Afrac vote; TangTV only labels (silver) are the TangTV vote with Afrac abstaining or invalid; bins where TangTV votes detached on a known L-mode phase or in a probable-L window (regime unknown, ELM-free, median P_in under 2 MW) are uncertain (tier tangtv_only_lmode). None is independent truth. Agreement does not establish accuracy; the Te rows of the vote before the gate are the check, and the shares in band of the label tiers are post-selection (the gate was added after the Te check flagged the L-mode bins).
population: all exported assessed eligible-shot bins, every split

bootstrap.undefined_draws: excluded; valid_replicates in the benchmark record

assessed_that_can_never_carry_a_state.reason: TangTV is invalid on the bin (a state needs a TangTV vote)

second_vote_effect.question: does requiring an agreeing second indicator improve the agreement of the TangTV state with divertor Thomson Te?

certain_minus_tangtv_before_gate.note: AUROC(-Te) of the certain bins minus that of every TangTV attached/detached vote on the upper shelf that has a Te; the certain bins are a subset of them

certain_minus_tangtv_where_second_vote_m.note: against the TangTV votes that are tangtv_only or in conflict

definitions.assessed: at least two valid measurements on an eligible shot, or a TangTV vote
definitions.certain: TangTV + Afrac agreement: assessed bin where the TangTV vote and an agreeing valid Afrac vote state attached or detached (not a confidence level)
definitions.tangtv_only_lmode: uncertain: TangTV votes detached (0.5 <= DZ < 1.2) on a known L-mode phase or in a probable-L window; the DZ cutoffs come from an H-mode shot. Only the detached vote is gated: L-mode inner-SOL leakage biases DZ upward, so a low DZ stays trustworthy
definitions.probable_L: regime unknown from every source, ELM coverage known, no ELM share in the window and median P_in under 2 MW (the Martin 2008 L-H threshold scaling gives about 1.7 to 2.4 MW for typical DIII-D parameters); an a-priori proxy, not a measured regime
definitions.vote_before_gate: the TangTV vote with no L-mode gate (filled markers of the Te panel); not the same population as the `no_second_voter` label composition, which has the gate applied
definitions.tangtv_only: assessed bin where TangTV votes and Afrac abstains or is invalid (silver)
definitions.conflict: TangTV and Afrac vote against each other; uncertain
definitions.candidate_marfe: uncertain bin with a sustained TangTV high front; no MARFE state is exported
definitions.uncertain: every other assessed bin; the tier says why
definitions.te_auroc: P(Te of a detached-vote bin < Te of an attached-vote bin); 0.5 is chance
definitions.seconds: bin count times bin_ms / 1000; disjoint bins, not spans
definitions.shots: unique contributing shots; state shot counts may overlap
definitions.measurement: finite scalar before indicator validity gates
definitions.certain_label: vote bin that also has a certain exported state
definitions.auroc: P(f_div of a TangTV not-attached bin > f_div of a TangTV attached bin); 0.5 is chance
definitions.spearman: rank correlation of f_div with DZ, both larger when more detached; 0 is chance
definitions.within_shot: mean over shots of the per-shot statistic, shots with enough bins of both classes
definitions.kappa_binary: Cohen's kappa of attached versus not attached (MARFE merged with detached); undefined, not drawn, when either indicator cast one class

thresholds.prad_cutoffs_note: f_div is not a vote of the label. Its relative votes (f_div over the shot baseline) and its absolute votes (global cutoffs, one pair for every shot, anchored on 201081) are sensitivities: docs/labeler/results/detachment_prad_anchor.json
